globalRules: Clean molded polymer uses the accepted M7 master material and does not require photographic albedo.
Dark turquoise and industrial gray carry the largest areas; hazard yellow and translucent neon green remain functional accents.

construction.loadPath: A wide tripod/service base carries a narrow segmented mast; the tracking head sits on explicit yaw and pitch bearings with power routed down the mast.
construction.modules: Tripod base, mast segments, yaw carriage, pitch cutter/scanner head, work lamp and service box.
construction.adaptationBoundary: Approved new content uses survey/cutter grammar; it may not gain missile pods, a conventional gun barrel or ground-target behavior.

motion.plantedContact: Three broad service feet remain fixed; upper tracking recoil cannot move the base.

pivots.name: Pivot_CutterYaw
pivots.motion: continuous bounded/unbounded yaw as allowed by cable design; forward service rest

pivots.name: Pivot_CutterPitch
pivots.motion: upward pitch from service rest to tracked elevation

beats: Idle performs a slow source-bounded survey check, then returns to rest.
Acquire yaws first, pitches second and changes the tracking signal.
Attack holds aim while the beam window plays, then cools and settles; gameplay damage is authoritative.
Brownout parks the head and extinguishes active signal; destruction folds mast sections in sequence.

unresolved: Cable-safe yaw range and exact head proportions require greybox review; the visible consequence is whether the mast can track behind itself without impossible hose twisting.
